resources.string: The SOS alarm was not sent. Nobody has been warned.
No SOS contacts are set up.
There is no SIM card and Telegram could not be reached.
The SMS and Telegram messages could not be sent.
Emergency number %1$s works even without a SIM card.
Alarm sent: %1$d by SMS, %2$d by Telegram.

Tip for your SOS contacts: on iPhone, turn on "Emergency Bypass" for this number; on Android, star it and allow starred contacts and repeat callers in Do Not Disturb. With this app on their phone, an SOS sounds as a loud alarm.
